dashboard.title: Invoices
dashboard.description: Official invoices and tax documents for paid bills.

summary.sandboxBanner: Invoices issued here are simulated — not legally valid. Switch to Production from Edit setup after AFIP/ARCA credentials validate.
summary.demoBanner: These invoices are practice documents only — not legally valid tax invoices. Switching Environment to Production here will not make them official.

setup.title: Invoice setup
setup.description: Update country, tax profile, or issuance mode. Changes apply to new paid bills.
setup.emptyDescription: Set this up once so Payverge can queue official invoices for paid bills.
setup.environmentDemoLocked: Demo tenants stay in Sandbox. To go live, set country to Argentina and complete AFIP/ARCA credentials — Production is not available for the demo provider.

fields.pointOfSaleHelp: Whole number assigned by your provider for this location.

setup.invalidPointOfSale: Point of sale must be a whole number.

credentials.title: AFIP credentials
credentials.description: Upload the digital certificate and private key issued by AFIP/ARCA so Payverge can request CAE authorizations on your behalf.
credentials.certHint: The X.509 certificate downloaded from AFIP.
credentials.keyHint: Your private key is encrypted at rest and is never shown again.
credentials.keyNeverStored: For your security, the private key is never displayed after upload.
credentials.missingFiles: Select both the certificate and the private key before uploading.
credentials.validateSuccess: Credentials validated. You're ready to issue invoices.
credentials.validateNeedsCredentials: Upload your certificate and private key first.

status.label: Setup status
status.draftHint: Upload your AFIP certificate and private key to continue.
status.credentialsSetHint: Validate the uploaded credentials against AFIP to finish setup.
status.readyHint: Credentials are valid. Payverge can request CAE authorizations.

region.title: E-invoicing
region.unavailableTitle: E-invoicing isn't available in your region yet
region.unavailableDescription: Payverge currently issues official electronic invoices for Argentina (AFIP/ARCA). E-invoicing is not available in {country} yet.
region.unavailablePathToLive: Path to live: when your country is supported, you'll upload provider credentials and switch Environment to Production from Edit setup.
region.demoDescription: This business issues simulated DEMO invoices only. They are not legally valid tax documents, and no real certificate upload is required.
region.demoPathToLive: Path to live: change country to Argentina, upload AFIP/ARCA credentials, validate them, then switch Environment to Production. Until then, treat every DEMO stamp as practice.

off.title: Off
off.description: Payverge will not issue invoices and the manual button is disabled.

manual.title: Manual
manual.description: Issue invoices yourself from the history when you're ready.

automatic_non_blocking.title: Automatic
automatic_non_blocking.description: Paid bills queue invoices in the background. Bills close even if the provider is slow.

history.title: Invoice history
history.description: Invoices queued for paid bills — including pending, authorized, and failed.
history.emptyDescription: Paid bills will appear here as soon as Payverge issues an invoice for them.
history.emptyDescriptionManual: Enter a paid bill’s ID below to issue your first invoice.
history.emptyDescriptionOff: Invoice issuance is off. Switch to Manual or Automatic from Edit setup to start queuing invoices for paid bills.

issue.hint: Use the Bill # from the Bills tab. The bill must be paid first.
issue.billNotFound: We couldn’t find a paid bill with that ID. Open the Bills tab to confirm the number.
issue.alreadyIssued: This bill already has an invoice. Open it from the Invoices list instead of issuing a second one.

creditNote.error: Could not issue the credit note.
creditNote.confirmDescription: This queues an official credit note (nota de crédito) that cancels invoice #{{bill}} with AFIP. This cannot be undone.
